Description

Do you want to build a career that is truly worthwhile? Working at the World Bank Group provides a unique opportunity for you to help our clients solve their greatest development challenges. The World Bank Group is one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries; a unique global partnership of five institutions dedicated to ending extreme poverty, increasing shared prosperity and promoting sustainable development. With 189 member countries and more than 120 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org.

The WBG Gender Department leads efforts to accelerate gender equality through analytics, operational support, and innovation. Within the Department, the Results & Innovation Team strengthens data-driven decision-making for design and implementation of policies and operations, and monitoring and reporting of gender outcomes, across sectors and regions. The team supports implementation of the Gender Strategy (2024–2030) and Targets, IDA21 Gender Policy commitment, the Gender Equality Scorecard, and gender portfolio indicators. This work requires high-quality data management, rigorous validation, and development of innovative tools, including AI-enabled solutions. The ETC will support these efforts under Senior Operations officers, working closely with the Outcomes Department, OPCS, ITS, CMUs, and regional teams. This support is made all the more pressing as the Outcomes department has downsized its gender team, shifting more responsibilities to our department.

Duties And Accountabilities

• Collect, clean, classify, and validate data for Gender Strategy indicators, IDA21 commitments, Gender Scorecard metrics, and gender portfolio indicators.
• Support development and refinement of dashboards for CMUs and Regions using Power BI and other tools.
• Support integration of gender indicators into AIMM Navigation and operational data systems, ensuring gender indicators are embedded in private sector measurement processes.
• Conduct deep-dive analyses and contribute to outcome monitoring.
• Contribute to development of Gender Intelligence AI tool.
• Help to integrate and align processes and application of methodologies across World Bank and IFC results data.
• Develop guidance notes, methodological approaches, and tools to support consistent and high-quality measurement of gender outcomes across portfolios. Produce analytical briefs summarizing gender indicator trends.
• Contribute to methodological and technical documentation (data dictionaries, validation notes).

Selection Criteria

• Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Public Policy, or related field (or Bachelor's + 5 years experience).
• Strong proficiency in statistics software (such as Python, R, SQL, PowerQuery, or Stata) and advanced Excel.
• Experience developing dashboards (Power BI preferred).
• Demonstrated ability to analyze and validate large, multi-source datasets.
• Detail-oriented, collaborative, proactive, and solution-focused.
• Ability to think and communicate clearly.
• Familiarity with WBG operations (particularly process and systems), gender analysis, or Scorecard reporting is an advantage.
• Proactive and solution oriented, with strong problem solving skills.
• Excellent organizational abilities and capacity to manage multiple deliverables across reporting cycles.
• Ability to use strong interpersonal and teamwork skills to cultivate effective, productive client relationships and partnerships and generate excitement around data

WBG Culture Attributes

• Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
• Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
• Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

Teksouth is a recognized leader in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics solutions for the federal government. With a reputation for excellence and innovation, Teksouth is a trusted partner across the defense sector, dedicated to being the indispensable architect of intelligent enterprise. We are committed to fundamentally transforming how organizations operate, make decisions, and innovate across every critical function, moving beyond traditional data reporting to deliver strategic, predictive, and actionable insights.

Position Overview - Teksouth is seeking a Data Scientist for a foundational "hands-on" role at the forefront of our innovation agenda, responsible for implementing Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI (GenAI) activities for our customers. The successful candidate will drive the maturation of our core data analytics offerings by identifying, validating, and scaling new, revenue-generating opportunities across our defense, federal, and commercial client base. This role reports directly to Teksouth's CTO team and Principal Data Scientist and will serve as a senior technical contributor to client engagements with significant autonomy in executing AI/ML solutions within established strategic and technical scope.

Key Responsibilities and Impact

A. Strategy, Vision, and Client Engagement

• End-to-End Solution Development: Proactively identify and scope high-impact GenAI/ML applications (e.g., text generation, code synthesis, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection) for client engagements, working with the Principal Data Scientist to prioritize opportunities relevant to client business requirements and pain points.

• Proposal Development: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and compelling business cases for executive leadership, contributing to and collaborating on the technical sections of proposals (RFPs, RFIs) that outline AI/ML solutions.

B. Solution Architecture and Deployment

• Solution Architecture and Implementation: Design and architect end-to-end GenAI/ML solutions for client engagements, including selecting and customizing appropriate models (LLMs, transformers, etc.) and defining scalable integration strategies for embedding AI into existing enterprise client systems (ERP, CRM), and ensuring scalable, maintainable solutions.

• MLOps and Implementation: Implement the required Teksouth technology stack, tools, and best practices for MLOps (Machine Learning Operations), ensuring models are scalable, reliable, and compliant. Provide recommendations to Teksouth's CTO team for stack improvements for client engagements.

• Technical Ownership and Deployment: Own complete technical lifecycle for assigned AL/ML engagements, from initial scoping to production deployment and sustainment. Balance technical tasks such as architectural decisions with project tasks such as schedule, risks, and stakeholder management.

C. Governance, Compliance, and Client Engagement

• Compliance and Documentation: Ensure all AL/ML solutions adhere to responsible AI principles, maintain documentation, and provide audit trails in accordance with Teksouth's established standards.

• Client Engagement: Serve as primary technical POC for client engagement, leading technical work, requirements gathering, and client-facing deliverables. Present technical approaches and results to stakeholders, including government program managers, SMEs, and leadership. Support the Teksouth CTO team in executive-level briefings and planning sessions.

Technical & Foundational Requirements

• Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience delivering machine learning or AI solutions, with at least 3 years in a project or workstream ownership role focused on architecture, development, and delivery.

• Education: Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. A PhD is preferred.

• Languages & Tools: Expert proficiency in Python (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace) and SQL.

• AI/ML Expertise: Deep understanding of a wide range of ML models (deep learning, NLP, time-series, clustering) and demonstrated accomplishments in GenAI models and approaches (LLMs, transformers, prompt engineering).

• Deployment: Expert proficiency in ML pipelines and cloud-based deployment (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google AI Platform), with experience integrating AI into enterprise applications via APIs.

Strategic & Leadership Requirements

• B2G/Defense Experience (Strongly Preferred): Proven experience successfully applying data science solutions within the Department of Defense (DoD) or large Federal Civilian agencies.

• Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of the unique data privacy, security, and compliance requirements (e.g., FedRAMP, CUI, DoD ILs) and mapping technology to business goals under these regulations.

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to create and deliver high-quality executive reports, dashboards, and training.

• Work Style: Independent thinker who can create the vision and execute on transforming data into high-end client products.

Join with the Inspector General to help make America’s railroad operate more efficiently and effectively. Our team provides independent oversight of Amtrak’s programs and operations and works diligently to prevent and detect fraud, waste, and abuse by Amtrak employees, contractors, or vendors. This work not only helps to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Amtrak, but it also informs decision-making by Amtrak’s Board of Directors, Amtrak management, and Congress. We employ a diverse team of auditors, special agents, analysts, forensic examiners, lawyers, and support staff to complete our exciting mission. Join us as we continue toward our goal of building a model OIG centered on independence, teamwork, diversity, work-life balance, and oversight that makes a difference!

SUMMARY OF DUTIES

The Data Scientist collects, prepares and analyzes data to help the OIG conduct audits and investigations of Amtrak (the company) programs and operations, in accordance with lawful standards. The incumbent will support complex audits and sensitive criminal, civil, and administrative investigations with data analytics strategies that help assess the economy, efficiency, and effectiveness of Amtrak programs and operations and help identify potential fraud, waste, and abuse. Evidence the incumbent develops may also be used by OIG investigators for civil or criminal accountability in conjunction with relevant United States Attorney Offices. The incumbent will work with OIG Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and company resources to access data, learn related business processes, identify relevant internal controls, ensure completeness and accuracy of the data, and generate business insights using advanced data analytics techniques such as machine learning and artificial intelligence.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Central Function for Oversight Analytics
• Serves as a subject‑matter expert on data science, advanced analytics, fraud detection, and quantitative risk assessment.
• Advances the strategic vision for audit and investigative analytics across the OIG.
• Takes direction from the Director and Senior Director of Data Analytics to prioritize analytic efforts but works independently without significant supervisory guidance in collecting, preparing, and analyzing data.
• Follows best practices and/or established analytic standards, methodologies, quality control practices to ensure compliance with OIG and company policies.
• Become an expert in using Alteryx as a primary tool for building analytic tests.

Fraud, Waste & Abuse Detection
• Designs, develops, and oversees advanced data analytics tests, statistical models, and machine learning solutions to detect potential fraud, waste, abuse, and improper payments.
• Builds risk‑scoring and prioritization frameworks to support audit planning and investigative targeting.

Internal Control & Risk Analytics
• Learns company systems and business processes and identifies internal controls relevant to analytic objectives.
• Conducts data‑driven assessments of internal control effectiveness by identifying systemic control weaknesses, compliance risks, and process inefficiencies across program areas.

Data Collection and Management
• Designs and implements automated data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) routines for complex and large datasets from internal and external systems.
• Monitors changes to source systems that affect data integrity, access, or analytics outputs.
• Independently prepares, cleans, normalizes, and validates data to ensure data integrity, completeness, and reliability prior to analytical use.
• Performs quality assurance reviews of others’ work and prepares own reports to a high degree of excellence.
• Meets with the company officials to obtain an accurate understanding of systems, business processes, and related data structures, for the purpose of informing analytical work.

Oversight Engagement Support
• Works with auditors and investigators to understand objectives, identify relevant data, brainstorm analytic approaches, and interpret results.
• Proposes expert analytic strategies using available tools to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and patterns across large and complex datasets.
• Ensures analytic evidence is reliable, sufficient, relevant, and defensible for audit findings or investigative use.

Communication, Visualization & Reporting
• Creates advanced visualizations, dashboards, exhibits, and automated reports that provide business insights and illustrate risk areas for audits and investigations.
• Prepares briefing materials, testimony, messages, and fact sheets that clearly and effectively communicate analytic methods and results to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
• Assists the Office of Counsel in litigation preparation and testifies as a data analytics expert when required.

Collaboration, Governance & Security
• Develops productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders at all organizational levels.
• Meets regularly with the team to discuss progress and obstacles and recommend solutions. Ensures work, information, ideas, and technology flow freely.
• Works with Data Engineers and OIG IT Mission Support to implement data governance, security, and access controls.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related quantitative field.
• 5+ years of progressive experience performing advanced data analytics in audit, investigation, fraud detection, or compliance environments.
• Expert proficiency with Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Alteryx, ACL, and cloud‑based analytics platforms.
• 3+ years of experience developing analytical solutions using cloud native tools and APIs for ETL, storage, and analysis.

PREFERRED:
• Master’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other fields related to data analysis, machine learning, artificial intelligence, business information management, or forensic accounting.
• Professional certifications such as CFE, CIA, CISA, or equivalent.
• Advanced proficiency performing statistical analysis using data analytics software packages, or cloud native tools.
• Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets.
• Knowledge of working with JSON format data, including parsing and stringifying.
• Experience designing and implementing Artificial Intelligence strategy.
• Experience presenting analytic evidence in criminal, civil, or administrative proceedings.
• Investigative experience with an emphasis on complex white-collar crimes involving contracts, procurement, vendors, finance, human resources, public corruption, revenue, and health care.
• Broad knowledge of the laws, practices, and procedures of federal Offices of Inspector General.
• Familiarity with passenger rail or transportation operations

COMPENSATION:

The hiring salary range for the Data Scientist is $124,600 - $160,500. This is the starting salary range and does not reflect the full salary range of the position. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, internal equity, etc. In addition to your salary, Amtrak OIG offers a comprehensive benefit package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts; wellness programs; flexible spending accounts; 401K retirement plan with employer match; life insurance; short and long term disability insurance; paid time off; back-up care; adoption assistance; surrogacy assistance; reimbursement of education expenses; Public Service Loan Forgiveness eligibility; Railroad Retirement sickness and retirement benefits; and rail pass privileges.
